properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 (pre-standard SHA-3 padding) hashing the UTF-8 message before ECDSA signing in KeyStoreManagerUtils.getECDSASignature — the Ethereum-standard digest. The ten pnpm-lock sites are @ethersproject/keccak256@5.7.0, a declared dependency of the mud-sandbox JS workspace (ethers-based contract tooling) shipping the same Keccak-256. Hashes face only Grover's square-root speedup; not urgent for PQ migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two faces of one KDF: HDNode.cs:87 derives a 64-byte BIP32/BIP39-style seed from a mnemonic with Rfc2898DeriveBytes at only 1000 iterations — far below BIP39's 2048 and OWASP's 600k (the low-iteration aspect is the separately-rated ALG-a861135a); the five pnpm-lock sites declare @ethersproject/pbkdf2 5.7.0 in the mud-sandbox workspace. PBKDF2 itself is a classical KDF but not Shor-relevant; the iteration count is the actionable parameter.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Encrypt-then-MAC authentication for the Web3Auth keystore envelope: HMAC-SHA256 keyed with the second half of the SHA-512(ECDH) output, computed over IV+ephemeral pubkey+ciphertext; decrypt() refuses on MAC failure. Sound construction (A-). Caveat recorded on the verify path: hmacSha256Verify compares hex strings with String.Equals (line 141) — non-constant-time comparison of a MAC. HMAC-SHA256 itself is not Shor-vulnerable; Grover only halves the tag length.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js@3.0.1 is the scrypt implementation declared in the mud-sandbox workspace's pnpm lockfile (pulled in by the ethers/@ethereumjs wallet tooling stack for key derivation — ethers uses scrypt for keystore files). Memory-hard KDF, sound classical and PQ posture; recorded because the build ships it. The C# Web3Auth keystore itself does not use scrypt — its KDF path is ECDH+SHA-512.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-256-CBC class encrypting Web3Auth key shares: BouncyCastle CipherUtilities "AES/CBC/PKCS7PADDING" with a 256-bit key taken as the first 32 bytes of SHA-512(ECDH-secp256k1 shared secret); Web3Auth.cs decrypts share metadata (:397-405) and re-encrypts device data (:458, :516-522) with an HMAC-SHA256 MAC over IV||ephemeral pubkey||ciphertext. AES-256 keeps a 128-bit Grover margin — no PQ migration needed for symmetric crypto. Changeable here (vendored Web3Auth plugin).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BouncyCastle SecureRandom is the entropy source for secp256k1 ECDSA keypair generation (generateECKeyPair) and the 16-byte keystore IV (generateRandomBytes) in the vendored Web3Auth keystore. CSPRNG in a security context — correct choice, recorded as the RNG posture, not a weakness. Changeable here only insofar as the whole vendored plugin is.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic@6.5.4 pinned in the mud-sandbox workspace's lockfile — classical EC crypto library (secp256k1 ECDSA signing, ECDH, EdDSA) used by the ethers/@ethereumjs toolchain.
